IGUI_KFM_Exam_HighFever: High fever. Many things can cause it.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_Fever: Feverish. Many things can cause it.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_Cold: Body is cold to the touch.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_WoundInflamed: %1: the wound looks inflamed, it may be getting infected.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_UnexplainedWeakness: Weaker than the visible wounds explain (blood loss, illness, hunger, exhaustion...).
IGUI_KFM_Exam_MoreSkill: With more First Aid skill you would notice more.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_Disclaimer: A field exam, not a lab: some things cannot be known.
IGUI_KFM_HelperHint: A helper next to the patient lowers the requirement by %1.
IGUI_KFM_MustRest: The patient must be sitting or lying down.
IGUI_KFM_Result_TourniquetOk: Tourniquet tight. Bleeding stopped for now.
IGUI_KFM_Result_TourniquetFail: Could not get the tourniquet tight enough.
IGUI_KFM_Result_CauterizeOk: Wound sealed. That will leave a mark.
IGUI_KFM_Result_CauterizeFail: Only burned it, the wound is still open.
IGUI_KFM_Result_ReduceOk: The bone is back in place.
IGUI_KFM_Result_ReduceFail: It did not go back in place. Made it worse.
IGUI_KFM_Result_DebrideOk: Infected tissue removed. Needs a bandage now.
IGUI_KFM_Result_DebrideFail: Could not remove all of it.
